card.name: Liver toxicity warnings in HIV drug labels
card.fires_on: Words inside liver-injury warning sentences in antiretroviral labels, such as 'may include' before hepatomegaly, commas in lists of liver symptoms, and the start of hepatotoxicity or hepatomegaly.
